title: Library Preparation Clean Up Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Empty, for liquid waste Slot 2: [Bio-Rad 96-Well Plate](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr), clean and empty Slot 3: [Bio-Rad 384-Well Plate](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-au/product/384-well-pcr-plates?ID=OCH4UM
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place a NEST 12‑well reservoir in Slot 1, a Bio‑Rad 96‑well plate (clean, empty) in Slot 2, and a Bio‑Rad 384‑well plate (clean, empty) in Slot 3 according to the deck map.

steps.title: Load tip rack and pipette
steps.instruction: Load a 50 µL/300 µL tip rack onto the mount that holds the P50‑Multi‑Channel pipette (choose left or right mount in the OT App).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the deck, tip rack, reservoir, and both destination plates for the P50‑Multi pipette.

steps.title: Select pipette mount in software
steps.instruction: In the OT App, specify whether the P50‑Multi is attached to the left or right mount before running the protocol.

steps.title: Run automated clean‑up
steps.instruction: Start the protocol; the robot will add magnetic beads from A1, 80 % fresh ethanol (~10 mL each) from A2‑A5, and RSB buffer from A6, engage the magnetic module to bind beads, perform the required washes, and disengage the magnet as programmed.

steps.title: Transfer final supernatant
steps.instruction: After the magnetic clean‑up, dispense 4 µL of the final supernatant into each well of the 384‑well plate and 20 µL into each well of the 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µL supernatant per well to the 384‑well plate.
Add 20 µL supernatant per well to the 96‑well plate.
